description: This script builds a PHP Archive (Phar) package from source files in a specific directory, setting metadata, providing an autoload stub, and compressing the archive.

classes.name: Phar
classes.description: The Phar class is used to create and manipulate PHP Archive (Phar) files, including adding files, setting stubs, and compressing archives.

methods.name: buildFromDirectory
methods.description: Builds the Phar archive from the contents of a directory.

methods.name: setStub
methods.description: Defines the entry point and bootstrap code for the Phar archive.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Sets metadata information for the Phar archive.

methods.name: compressFiles
methods.description: Compresses files within the Phar archive using the specified compression.
